description.value: Red Burrito is a Vancouver-born Mexican restaurant chain that has been making fresh, house-made burritos, tacos, and tamales since 2006. The Cambie Street location sits along one of Vancouver's primary cycling corridors and offers both indoor and outdoor seating. Handmade tamales, tortilla soup, and a catering programme round out a menu built around daily-fresh ingredients.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Cambie location at 2328 Cambie Street with phone 604-707-8880, matching OSM tags exactly. The menu page explicitly lists a Vegetarian option and a Vegan Meat option, supporting that amenity. No website or OSM evidence exists for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
concerns: Internal website inconsistency: the homepage states '4 locations in Vancouver and North Vancouver' while the Our Story subpage states '3 locations in Vancouver' — the site may not be fully up to date.
Website footer copyright reads '2020-2022', suggesting the site is not actively maintained, though location and contact details appear current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant is a confirmed operating business on the Cambie cycling corridor with food and vegetarian/vegan options useful to touring cyclists, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence and should be verified on-site before inclusion.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists a dedicated Vegetarian filling (Spanish rice, beans, toppings, fresh guacamole) and a Vegan Meat filling (soy-based protein seasoned in house spices). No gluten-free option mentioned
